cookies.title: Cookie-free statement
cookies.lead: {product} sets no advertising or analytics cookies, loads no third-party scripts, and does no fingerprinting.
cookies.storesOffline: Your browser keeps your plan, your entries, and the prices fetched for your coins on this device, so the app works offline. It keeps the app's files, so the app opens offline. It keeps the pages you opened for up to 7 days and the latest price data for 24 hours, so they show offline. It keeps the date each copy was saved, so copies past their limit are cleared.
cookies.storesSettings: Your browser also keeps your display settings (theme, reduced motion, chart range, and the Log's view), so they stay as you chose them. It keeps the dates of your last JSON backup and your last change, so the app can remind you to export a copy. It keeps the banners you dismissed, so they stay hidden. It keeps the date of your last annual review, so the next review shows when it is due.
cookies.storesRecords: Your browser keeps a record of the entries you deleted on this device, so an import with Add missing entries only cannot bring them back. It keeps the plan and entries that Replace everything removed, in full and marked as deleted, so that import cannot bring the entries back either. These records stay until you choose Delete everything in Settings or clear this site's data in your browser.
cookies.storesSync: It keeps a random identifier for this device, so your changes apply in the order you made them. It does not leave this browser: no request and no backup carries it. It keeps a copy of each change to your plan and entries, for syncing between devices, which the app does not offer. It keeps any stored data that failed its check when read, set aside instead of deleted, so a failed check erases nothing. Delete everything in Settings clears these too.
cookies.storesTab: Your browser keeps form drafts until the tab closes, so what you typed comes back when you return to the form. After an update, if part of the app fails to load, the tab keeps a short note until it closes, so it reloads only once.

contact.title: Contact

contact.security: Report a security issue to the address in security.txt. You get an acknowledgement within 72 hours. Good-faith research does not lead to legal action when it accesses no data beyond what proves the issue, does not disrupt the service, and is not made public before a fix. Credit on request.
